prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Adoption photo and style tools (photo quality hints, style selectors, pre-upload inspection, compact photo grids), sign-in session safeguard hints and retrieval flows, clear desktop control hints/copy, compact welcome dashboards, and waiting readiness hints/carousels.
Hurt performance: Desktop finish redesigns, banners, and taskbar guidance copy, pre-adoption photo prep screens, pre/post-certificate sign-in stage shifts, path speed helper callouts, story scroll intros, and instant activation incentives.
No clear effect seen: Audio and background notifications, adoption certificate incentive badges, account persistence verification flows, two-column or carousel path layouts, and most waiting progress checklists.
Predictions were too low: Gains were underestimated for clear desktop control copy, tray visibility hints, compact welcome dashboards, post-waiting auth reorders, path reassurance hints, and session safeguard hints.
Predictions were too high: Gains were overestimated for desktop finish redesigns, preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in stage shifts, split-view story intros, instant activation incentives, and any tests resulting in negative performance.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Account Auth Reorder Stage: Reorder sign_in to occur after photo upload and pick_friend steps right before waiting screen to ensure pet creation data is preserved. (why: 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets after signing in again; placing sign-in right before waiting locks pet state to account prior to generation.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] New Custom Pet Validation Screen: Insert a dedicated pre-generation pet inspect screen (new_pet_inspect) right after photo upload to review parameters before submitting. (why: 3 support emails report custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results, and mean adoption step time is 1017s.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Companion Desktop Control Onboarding Flow: Introduce a multi-step desktop controls guidance flow ending with explicit tray icon and interaction key overview. (why: Finish step has lowest conversion (72.0%) with long mean time (5815s) and multiple support tickets asking how to hide, control, or talk to the pet.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Sign-In Safeguard Hint: Add an explicit session persistence hint on the sign_in screen clarifying that existing pet data will be safely linked. (why: 8 support emails complained that pets were missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Spawn Status Wait Info: Enhance the waiting screen with status text explaining background engine rendering and desktop overlay initialization. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to open properly, and home step mean time is high (2336s).)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Copy: Update headline and body on home_intro to clearly explain tray controls, key shortcuts, and visibility toggles. (why: Support mails highlight confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to pets upon reaching home screen.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Identity Badge Incentive: Add an official adoption seal badge component on the adoption certificate screen to celebrate companion naming. (why: Adoption step has high drop-off in mean time (1017s); reinforcing adoption identity increases emotional engagement.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Readiness Sound Notification: Add audio chime component and desktop notification toggle on waiting screen when rendering finishes. (why: Home median time is 201s (mean 2336s), showing users step away while waiting for generation.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Compact Choice Grid Layout: Change choose_path screen layout to compact split view to highlight path differences immediately. (why: choose_path mean time is 514s, indicating initial friction selecting between path options.)

scores.note: Stage shifts for sign-in historically hurt performance despite user support reports.
New screens require full release; inspection tools help but extra pre-adoption screens risk drop-off.
Finish step has massive drop-off and strong email evidence, but complex new flows severely regressed in past tests.
Session safeguard hints address specific user complaints and past gains were underestimated.
Waiting screen readiness hints consistently show positive returns across 12 prior tests.
Finish step drops 28% of users; clear control copy is cheap and gains were previously underestimated.
Incentive badges show no clear effect or slight negative impact in past trials.
Home step has long wait time, but audio notifications have shown mixed/no clear impact.
Split-view and multi-column path layouts historically showed negative or negligible lift.
